name: 一括選択と解除を備える航空会社の条件一覧
prompt:
Create a clean Japanese airline-filter list on a white canvas, close to the original 1080:1006 crop proportion. Use the source crop for row geometry, logo placement, checkbox alignment, spacing, and the disabled row. Use the Japanese preview for exact copy, teal-green actions, and the localized component boundary. Show only the Airlines section; omit time filters, top reset controls, the results button, and all app navigation.

At the top left, show the bold heading “航空会社”. Below it, align two compact text actions on one row: teal-green “すべて選択” and muted gray “解除”. Then show exactly five airline rows in source order with small airline marks at left, Japanese labels beside them, and empty square checkboxes in one right-aligned column:
1. Alaska mark — “アラスカ航空”
2. American Airlines mark — “アメリカン航空”
3. Frontier mark — “フロンティア航空”
4. JetBlue wordmark — “ジェットブルー航空” (disabled row: light gray label and very pale checkbox)
5. Southwest heart mark — “サウスウエスト航空”

Below the list, place the teal-green action “さらに表示”. Keep the airline marks small and visually faithful to the references: Alaska face emblem, red-blue American slash, green Frontier stripes, blue JetBlue wordmark, and red-yellow-blue Southwest heart. Keep logos secondary to the labels.

Use a restrained Japanese sans-serif similar to the preview, dark labels, ample row spacing, thin gray empty checkbox outlines, the disabled JetBlue state, and subtle teal-green action text. Preserve the reference hierarchy and uncluttered white space.

Do not add time ranges, filters, a top “Reset all” bar, a search icon, a results count, a blue CTA, dividers between rows, extra airlines, selected checkboxes, or watermark.
reviewNotes: Japanese airline filter list; visually reviewed for five rows, bulk actions, disabled state and clipping.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
